title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the time taken for the radius to decrease to zero must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Energy Loss Rate
description: Important Criteria: The expression for the rate of energy loss per revolution must be correctly stated and derived.

title: Acceleration Expression
description: Important Criteria: The expression for the acceleration of the electron in the Coulomb field must be correctly derived.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The setup of the integral for calculating the total time must be correctly formulated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units used throughout the derivation should be consistent and correctly applied.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing negative signs or incorrect limits in the integration process can lead to incorrect results.

title: Physical Assumptions
description: Optional Criteria: The assumptions made regarding nonrelativistic motion and small energy loss should be clearly stated.
